title: Yellow Fried Chinese Banana Fritters
description: A spicy and cozy Chinese dish featuring fried ripe bananas, this recipe is halal-friendly and served in a mason jar.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, sugar, salt, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dip each banana into the batter, coating completely, then carefully place into the hot oil.
Fry the bananas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the bananas from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the fried bananas with sesame seeds and scallions.
Serve the banana fritters in a mason jar and enjoy immediately.
